text:
rachel: Quick heads-up — merged ember-lora-v3 into cust/ember/v3 and published an int4 q4f build to canary. Running the customer quickpack shows embedding/ranking drift. Opening triage.

Tom: Paste the eval summary and model tag?

rachel: Model: ember-lora-v3-q4f (LoRA merge -> bnb q4f). Eval cmd: 
```
rwi-eval run --suite ember-quickpack --model ember-lora-v3-q4f --batch 128 --cache on
```
Results: precision@1 0.61 (int8 baseline 0.85), Spearman 0.42 (baseline 0.71), median_latency 30ms (baseline 46ms). Many top-3 swaps.

kevin: Any tokenizer or preproc changes in the PR?

rachel: Nope — adapter-only merge. Quant config used: 
```
quant_backend: bnb
quant_mode: q4f
adapter_only: true
per_layer_scaling: true
```
Toggled cache, same issue.

ci-bot: Regression ticket RG-2024-1102-03 created: https://issues.redwood.ai/RG-2024-1102-03

Tom: My suspicion is bnb per-layer scales moving adapter outputs. Quick experiments: 1) rerun using nf4 backend 2) rerun q4f with per_layer_scaling=false. I'll run both.

Tom: NF4 run done -> precision@1 0.79, Spearman 0.65, latency ~33ms. Better but not full recovery.

kevin: Run adapter-aware quantizer if available, and do a layer-scan to find sensitive adapter ranks.

rachel: Running layer-scan: 
```
rwi-eval run --suite ember-quickpack --model ember-lora-v3-q4f --layer-scan true --quant-backend bnb --output /tmp/ember-layerscan.json
```
Summary: adapter projection layers 2-4 show largest displacement with bnb q4f + per-layer scaling.

Tom: Proposal: 1) rollback canary to int8 for customer traffic 2) patch quant pipeline to prefer nf4 for adapter-only LoRAs or enable adapter-aware quantizer by default 3) add quickpack embedding drift gate in CI.

rachel: Rollback PR created: `rwi-deploy promote --model ember-lora-v3-int8 --route canary/ember --reason "restore embed quality"`

deploy-bot: Deployment event: promoted ember-lora-v3-int8 -> canary/ember (change id: DPL-9344)

kevin: I'll investigate bnb per-layer scale math and whether scale placement or calibration is misaligned for low-rank adapters. Tom, can you open a pipeline PR with a small grid (q4f/nf4 x per_layer_scaling true/false x adapter-aware flag)? Attach artifacts.

ci-bot: Artifacts uploaded: https://artifacts.redwood.ai/evals/ember/1732109999-grid.json

rachel: Notifying CS and holding customer traffic on canary until we validate a patched quant config. End thread for now.
